comments.author: Wth?
comments.html: Was it a sudden thing when you decided you hate your audience or did it grow gradually? That last story line…

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.html: I don’t hate my audience! I hate myself… Which storyline do you mean? My Boyfriend Smells or Mann’s Search for Meenie? I really like Mann’s Search for Meenie – was it no good? I really want to go ahead with My Boyfriend but it would have to be in B & W. I’m concerned, you really feel hate coming from me?

comments.author: Drew
comments.html: These stories are great. I’m very much looking forward to the conclusions of Mann’s Search and Curious Urgency (which it looks like you’re working on).

comments.author: Sam
comments.html: Yeah, I’m also really enjoying these stories.

comments.author: Jarrod
comments.html: What’s the deal, Kat and Wth? Seriously, why do you not like the recent comics? It’s fine to have your own opinion and everything, but can you please at least explain why you don’t like them instead of leaving such ambiguous posts?
